news.title: International security and defence: Is it time for universities to step up?
news.summary_en: In her latest column for The PIE, Diana Beech asks whether universities can keep their doors open to the world while guarding against growing security threats – and why getting that balance right has never mattered more.
news.author: Diana Beech

news.title: Curtin vows to fight WA mega-university merger
news.summary_en: Curtin University has vowed to “vigorously oppose” plans to merge three of Western Australia’s biggest universities, warning the proposed mega-institution would bring “cost, waste and loss of choice”.
news.author: Kim Martin

news.title: TrustEd framework and consistent visa process should enhance Ireland’s position
news.summary_en: Ireland remains well placed to attract international students, but uncertainty over visas and the implementation of new quality standards could shape its ability to capitalise on that demand, according to speakers preparing for The PIE Live Ireland.
news.author: Amy Baker

news.title: US probes nine unis over J-1 visas and suspends firms’ green card pathway
news.summary_en: US universities face allegations of using J-1 visas to undercut American researchers’ wages, while a separate suspension at eight major employers threatens to delay permanent residency applications for foreign workers.
news.author: Abhishek Nair

news.title: US to seek expedited appeal over blocked int’l student time limits
news.summary_en: The government and higher education groups face an October 9 deadline to set out their positions, with four-year admission limits still on hold nationwide.
news.author: Abhishek Nair
